name: Buy-the-dip: enter after an N% down bar, hold k bars
author: Daniel Rodriguez (backtrader samples)
indicators: pctdown by approach: close/close[-1]-1, close/open-1, close/high-1 or low/high-1 (default highlow)
implementation_notes: Sample/demo strategy; default 'highlow' approach uses the bar's own range -> it signals on the close of the bar, entry at next open in backtrader. Sample accompanied by a Reddit thread reference in the docs I did not open.
